🏅 MGR SCHOOL RANKING — TIERS 1–10 • RANKS 1–100

COMPLETE MGR RANKING

10 Tiers · 100 Ranks · Original MGR Geometric Symbols

Each Tier contains exactly 10 ranks. Every rank uses the symbol, colours, shape, meaning and qualification days from the supplied MGR ranking software.

100Ranks
10Tiers
Qualification30 days per rank
Rank 130 days
Rank 1003,000 days
AcceptanceMonthly approval must be accepted
Promotion & salary: The ranking does not calculate or reduce salary. Where a school promotion requires a particular rank, the required rank must be reached and verified before that promotion benefit can take effect. Missed/unaccepted service cycles do not count.
Authorised administrators can view retained name, contact, final rank and qualification record.
Beyond Rank 100 — Prestige Extension
Rank 1,000 time30,000 days ≈ 82.14 years
BasisSCL extension assumes 30 qualification days per rank after Rank 100; the supplied MGR source itself defines ranks through 100.

The supplied MGR software defines the complete geometric system through Rank 100. SCL will continue the service record beyond 100 using repeating MGR geometric motifs and a higher prestige naming layer.
